drive.description: Road-wheel roll (mean axle side-gear angle) about +X; positive rolls forward (-Z)

diff_front.description: Front differential split: left (+X) side gear +, right side gear - (half difference)

diff_rear.description: Rear differential split: left (+X) side gear +, right side gear - (half difference)

notes: Source: data/models-annotated/42083-1.mpd (Philippe Hurbain [Philo], CCAL 2.0), section '42083 - chiron.ldr', unmodified. Standalone extract written by scripts/extract_subsystem.py --section in the same frame (LDU, -Y up, front -Z, car's left +X); motion authored on source IDs and remapped (source/idmap.json).
Ratios, signs, pivots and link lengths are measured from library connector frames by scripts/build_42083_mechanisms.py; embedded DATs use their library part's frames for analysis only.
Kinematic and transform checks do not prove collision-free or physically feasible motion.
Interfaces (gearbox 24T input shaft, D/N/R 16T clutch gear 1/57) are driven context only.
Hubs turn at the half-shaft rate through the spindle drivers (CV assumption); exact Cardan at each diff.
Suspension and steering are static (not selected); front wheels stay straight.

rear_axle.label: Rear differential, Cardan half shafts and wheels
notes: 28T ring / 20T pinion: pinion = -1.4000 x carrier (about +Z / +X)
l half shaft bend 20.3 deg: exact cardan at the diff, spindle driver turns the hub at the half-shaft rate (CV assumption)
r half shaft bend 20.3 deg: exact cardan at the diff, spindle driver turns the hub at the half-shaft rate (CV assumption)
rear_axle.review: Measured motion declared in this plan; see notes and scripts/build_42083_mechanisms.py

front_axle.label: Front differential, half shafts and wheels
notes: 28T ring / 20T pinion: pinion = +1.4000 x carrier (about +Z / +X)
l half shaft bend 0.0 deg: exact cardan at the diff, spindle driver turns the hub at the half-shaft rate (CV assumption)
r half shaft bend 0.0 deg: exact cardan at the diff, spindle driver turns the hub at the half-shaft rate (CV assumption)
front_axle.review: Measured motion declared in this plan; see notes and scripts/build_42083_mechanisms.py

main_shaft.label: Locked main shaft and front pinion (all-wheel drive, no centre differential)
notes: No centre differential: both carriers = drive, front pinion +1.4000 = 16:16 (-1) x rear pinion -1.4000 (checked equal, so front and rear wheels roll together)
